name: Luminous Feathered Waterfall
description: A waterfall composed of glowing, semi‑transparent feathers that drift downward, leaving trails of soft light.
prompt: A vertical cascade where each droplet is a luminous feather — white, gold, pale blue — glowing from within. Feathers float slowly, creating a veil of light. Mist catches the glow, forming halos. Ethereal, high‑detail, slow‑motion feel, 8K.
caption: Feathers fall like liquid light. 🪶✨ #LuminousFeatheredWaterfall
